json.use_instead: figma_inspect {"node_ids":["1:2"],"depth":0} — reads the same nodes in ONE call (one line per node: TYPE "name" #id WxH @x,y [layout] fill font "text" →component variant), every id at once; a long reply pages with offset=K. Hand-written read #1 in a row: each is a full model turn that re-sends the whole conversation. figma_inspect also does: find / find_text (search names / text under node_ids), props:[...] (exact values: "font", "text", "layout", "padding", "props" = componentProperties, "variant", "main", "reactions", or any raw property), context:true (parent sections, breakpoints, component variants), view:"map" (canvas map), view:"table" (per table: headers, widths, cell contents and variant counts per column, row/cell ids), check (pass/fail), like:'<ref id>' finds the copies of a correct node under node_ids and lists how each differs, then REF lines with the reference's exact values, compare:'<ref id>' lists how each node_id differs from the reference, then REF lines with its exact values to copy into the write.
